title: osf review: a multi-agent, lens-based review pipeline
summary: This change adds a whole review subsystem to osf. A repository selects coding agents in `osf.toml` under `[agents]`; `osf review run` picks the review lenses a change earns from its diff content and tier, runs each roster reviewer headless in a clean copy of the change (no agent settings, no symlinks, read-only tools), validates each answer against a JSON Schema and against the files it quotes, and reduces the answers to one verdict per lens and one for the review. `osf review reduce` does the deciding from saved per-reviewer files, and a new `review.yml` workflow builds osf from the base branch, runs each reviewer in its own job with only its own provider key, and posts the result. Alongside it, suppression markers gain rule ownership, `osf scan` gains `--no-suppress`, and the agent list becomes the single source of truth for commands, hooks, login paths and read-only modes.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf/src
lanes.summary: The command surface: `review run`, `review reduce`, `review work-item`, `agents list`, `hooks install --agents`, and `scan --no-suppress`.

lanes.label: Review core
lanes.subtitle: lenses, prompts, context, answers
lanes.summary: Selects lenses, assembles the prompt metadata, validates answers, and checks quoted findings against the files.

lanes.label: Agents and reviewers
lanes.subtitle: agent list, roster, harnesses
lanes.summary: The one list of agents osf can drive, the roster built from `[agents]`, and the headless harness that runs one reviewer.

lanes.label: Decide and record
lanes.subtitle: reducer, journal, SARIF, post
lanes.summary: Turns verified answers into a lens verdict and a review verdict, journals both, and posts the kept findings.

lanes.subtitle: workflows, osf.toml, moon

nodes.label: review run
nodes.subtitle: review_run_cmd
nodes.summary: Runs every roster reviewer over the selected lenses, or with `--reviewer` runs one and saves what it did. `--if-enabled` skips cleanly when no reviewer is configured; `--warn-only` always exits 0.

nodes.label: review reduce
nodes.subtitle: review_reduce_cmd
nodes.summary: Reads the saved per-reviewer files, checks each against the binding, decides, journals, writes SARIF and posts.

nodes.label: review work-item
nodes.subtitle: review_work_item_cmd
nodes.summary: Finds the issue a pull request names on its Issue line or closes, and saves its text for the reviewer jobs.

nodes.label: agents list
nodes.subtitle: agents_list_cmd
nodes.summary: Prints every agent with what `[agents]` selects: enabled, builder, reviewer, model, hook settings.

nodes.label: hooks install --agents
nodes.subtitle: hooks_install_agents_cmd
nodes.summary: Writes each enabled agent's stop and prompt hook settings under `--root`, replacing a file already there.

nodes.label: scan --no-suppress
nodes.subtitle: scan_cmd
nodes.summary: Ignores every osf-disable marker and reports everything; CI now uses it.

nodes.label: Lens catalogue
nodes.subtitle: lenses.rs
nodes.summary: Loads the twenty shipped lenses, then the organisation's folder, then the repository's `.osf/review-lenses/*.toml`, a later file replacing an earlier lens of the same name. Selects lenses by run rule, trigger path or trigger signal.

nodes.label: Prompt renderer
nodes.subtitle: review_prompt.rs
nodes.summary: Fills the shipped or repository prompt file's placeholders once, left to right, and appends the fixed answer format so no file can break parsing. A prompt file that links outside the config root is refused.

nodes.label: Prompt metadata
nodes.subtitle: review_context.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the pull request, commits, changed files, work item and decision-record sections, and redacts every match of osf scan's own rules before the text reaches a reviewer. Also writes the read-only change folder holding the diff and commit log.

nodes.label: Answer schema and validation
nodes.subtitle: answer.rs
nodes.summary: Validates a reviewer's final message against the shipped JSON Schema, then against the two things the schema cannot express: the answer is for this lens, and every criterion has a score. Falls back to fenced code blocks, last to first.

nodes.label: Quote verification
nodes.subtitle: quotes.rs
nodes.summary: Checks each finding's quote against the file and line it names, within two lines of drift, with shape rules for short quotes. Only a VerifiedAnswer can be scored, so no unverified finding ever reaches the reducer.

nodes.label: Agent list
nodes.subtitle: agents.rs
nodes.summary: The one list of agents osf can drive: dsh, omp, opencode, codex, claude. Each entry carries its family, command, hook wiring, project settings, read-only mode, credential variables and login paths. `resolve` checks `[agents]` against it.

nodes.label: Reviewer roster and harness
nodes.subtitle: reviewers.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the roster from `[agents] reviewers`, and runs one reviewer headless in a fresh home holding only its own login files and credential variables, with a timeout and a tree kill.

nodes.label: Clean copy
nodes.subtitle: clean_copy.rs
nodes.summary: Copies the change's tracked and untracked files into a temp folder, leaving out every agent's project settings and every symbolic link, so the change cannot configure the agent that reviews it.

nodes.label: Builder family detection
nodes.subtitle: builder.rs
nodes.summary: Reads each commit's `Code-Generator:` trailer in the reviewed range and maps the model name to a family, so a reviewer from the builder's own family sits the change out.

nodes.label: Process tree kill
nodes.subtitle: process.rs
nodes.summary: Kills a child and every process it spawned, shared by moon.rs and reviewers.rs.

nodes.label: Reducer
nodes.subtitle: reducer.rs
nodes.summary: Decides one lens from its answers by fixed, order-independent rules: two families with two answered rounds each, or one family with a critical round. A blocker or must-fix vetoes; the review verdict is the weighted mean against the threshold.

nodes.label: Journal
nodes.subtitle: journal.rs
nodes.summary: Gains ReviewAnswer and ReviewDecision payloads. The replay hash drops a review answer's transcript path, a per-run temporary location, so identical decisions hash the same.

nodes.label: Review run orchestration
nodes.subtitle: review_run.rs
nodes.summary: Ties it together: setup, one reviewer's attempts per lens, the binding a saved run is checked against, and the reduce step that journals every answer and the decision.

nodes.label: Secret value redaction
nodes.subtitle: secret_values.rs
nodes.summary: Removes the exact values of the secrets the job holds from reviewer-written text before it leaves a reviewer run, and again before it reaches SARIF, a printed line or a posted review.

nodes.label: Work item lookup
nodes.subtitle: work_item.rs
nodes.summary: Finds the issue a pull request names or closes, reads its text, and checks a saved work item against the repository and head it was saved for.

nodes.label: Review and agents config
nodes.subtitle: config.rs
nodes.summary: Reads `[review]` (threshold, timeout, cost ceiling, hot paths, prompt file, builder family aliases) and `[agents]` from the repository's own osf.toml, and drops both tables before the layered Config loads so they never trip deny_unknown_fields.

nodes.label: Changeset risk signals
nodes.subtitle: changeset_risk.rs
nodes.summary: Reads the diff's own content, not just paths, to earn the review-lens trigger signals: public surface, concurrency, new-file, repeated-logic, high-traffic path. `hot_paths` is read from the trusted config root.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: .github/workflows/review.yml
nodes.summary: Builds osf from the base branch with no provider key, runs each reviewer in its own job with only its own key and a network list, then one job collects the saved answers, mints the verifier app's token, decides and posts.

nodes.label: ci.yml
nodes.subtitle: .github/workflows/ci.yml
nodes.summary: The scan step now passes `--no-suppress`, so CI reports every finding whatever a marker says.

nodes.label: moon review task
nodes.subtitle: .osf/moon.yml
nodes.summary: Runs `osf review run --if-enabled --warn-only` in the builder's own workspace, where the exit code is never trusted to gate anything.

nodes.label: Suppression ownership
nodes.subtitle: osf-lint-core/src/suppress.rs
nodes.summary: A marker is validated against every rule id in the tool, but reported unused only by a checker that owns one of its named rules. A marker with no reason no longer suppresses anything.

edges.label: redact

edges.label: assess

edges.label: Selection, Review

edges.label: kill_tree

edges.label: project_settings
edges.summary: Which names are left out of the copy comes from the agent list.

edges.label: scan rules
edges.summary: The same scan rules that stop a secret reaching a public repository redact the prompt metadata first.

edges.label: find
edges.summary: Finds the issue the pull request names or closes.

edges.label: selection

edges.label: write_hooks

edges.label: osf review run --reviewer
edges.summary: Each reviewer job runs one reviewer and saves what it did.

edges.label: osf review reduce --post-to
edges.summary: The last job collects the saved answers, decides and posts.

edges.label: osf review work-item
edges.summary: The build job finds the work item with a read-only token and saves it for the reviewer jobs.

edges.label: --no-suppress
edges.summary: CI now reports every finding whatever a marker says.

edges.label: --if-enabled --warn-only
edges.summary: The moon task skips cleanly with no reviewer configured and never gates on its own exit code.

edges.label: apply_suppressions
edges.summary: Scan findings are suppressed unless `--no-suppress` is given, and only a marker this checker owns is reported unused.

edges.label: AgentsConfig
edges.summary: `[agents]` is read from the repository's own osf.toml and checked against the list.

flows.title: One reviewer's run over one lens
flows.summary: What happens between `osf review run --reviewer codex` starting and a saved file of attempts landing: setup from the trusted config root, a clean copy and a read-only change folder, then up to three attempts at the lens, each validated and redacted before it is saved.

messages.label: Request {root, config_root, base, binding}
messages.note: The config root is the base tree, so a pull request cannot weaken its own review by editing a lens or lowering the threshold.

messages.label: load lenses, assess risk, select
messages.note: The change's tier and earned signals decide which lenses run; the roster comes from `[agents] reviewers`.

messages.label: CleanCopy + ChangeFolder
messages.note: A clean copy of the change with no agent settings and no symlinks, and a read-only folder holding the diff and commit log.

messages.label: prompt, workdir, timeout
messages.note: The prompt is the trusted file with its placeholders filled, plus the fixed answer format.

messages.label: final message
messages.note: The harness's final message is parsed as JSON first, then as fenced blocks last to first.

messages.label: Answer {lens, scores, findings}
messages.note: Validated against the schema, the lens name, and every criterion scored.

messages.label: round 2, then critical round 3
messages.note: Two independent rounds, and a critical round only when the reviewer answered at all.

messages.label: ReviewerRun saved to --out
messages.note: Nothing is journaled or posted here; `review reduce` does that.

flows.title: Reduce saved answers to a posted review
flows.summary: What `osf review reduce` does with the per-reviewer files: bind each to this pull request, commit and CI run, check every quote against the files, decide each lens and the review, journal both, and post.

messages.label: saved files + Binding
messages.note: A file counts only when its name is the reviewer's own, no other file carries it, and its binding equals the expected one.

messages.label: Answer per attempt
messages.note: Each finding's quote is checked against the file and line it names, within two lines of drift.

messages.label: VerifiedAnswer
messages.note: Only a VerifiedAnswer can be scored, so no unverified finding ever reaches the reducer.

messages.label: decide_lens
messages.note: Two families with two answered rounds each, or one family with a critical round; a blocker or must-fix vetoes.

messages.label: ReviewAnswer per attempt
messages.note: A journal that cannot record makes the run could-not-run rather than reporting a verdict nothing backs up.

messages.label: Verdict {pass, fail, could-not-run}
messages.note: Any could-not-run lens makes the whole review could-not-run; otherwise the weighted mean against the threshold.

messages.label: SARIF + posted review
messages.note: A failed post makes the run could-not-run: the gate must never see a clean exit code with no review evidence behind it.

steps.body: The diff's own content and the tier decide which of the twenty lenses run.

steps.heading: A reviewer runs in a clean copy
steps.body: No agent settings, no symlinks, read-only tools, only its own key.

steps.heading: Answers are checked, then weighed
steps.body: Quotes are verified against the files before any score counts.
